hha_blood.msg.hunted_start: Someone caught the scent of your blood ...
hha_blood.msg.hunted_end: You are no longer being hunted
hha_blood.tracker.title: Blood Tracker
hha_blood.tracker.pick: Whose blood do you want to hunt? (%ss)
item.hha_blood.blood_ingot.lore1: Crimson alloy for smithing Blood's Armor
item.hha_blood.blood_helmet.lore2: Blood Tracker [Ability 4]: pick a player within %s blocks - a vein of blood only you can see leads you to them
item.hha_blood.blood_helmet.lore3: Hunt lasts %ss, then %ss cooldown (also when ended early). The prey feels that it is hunted
item.hha_blood.blood_chestplate.lore2: Enduring Effects: all beneficial effects last x%s longer. Weaving always lasts %ss, Turtle Master (Resistance) %ss and its Slowness only lasts half as long
item.hha_blood.blood_chestplate.lore3: Set: Ability 1 Nihil - enemies within %s blocks float slowly into the air like after a shulker hit, are stunned and drained for %ss (lifesteal) (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_chestplate.lore4: On the third beat a giant blood thorn bursts out of the ground under every enemy and impales it (%s damage), then a Blood Nova rolls out: %s damage and bleeding for everyone
item.hha_blood.blood_leggings.lore1: Infection: %s%% chance on hit to make the target bleed (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_leggings.lore2: Blood Trail [Ability 2]: dive into blood - fully invisible for %ss, armour and held items included (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_leggings.lore3: Enemies within %s blocks take %s damage, bleed and get %ss of Slowness VI
item.hha_blood.blood_boots.lore2: Blood Rush: hitting a bleeding enemy grants Speed II for %ss
item.hha_blood.blood_sword.lore1: Hemorrhage: bleeding enemies take x%s damage from all hits
item.hha_blood.blood_sword.lore2: Right-click: Bloodsaws - 2 spinning saw blades that bounce off walls and ricochet from enemy to enemy, never back to you (%s dmg, %ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_sword.lore3: Both saws hit together: Blood Fountain - bleed + %s dmg in %s blocks
item.hha_blood.blood_mace.lore2: Right-click: Blood Cyclone - the mace hovers spinning above the spot and shoots blood bolts at everything inside the marked circle of %s blocks (%s dmg + Infection, %ss cooldown)
item.hha_blood.blood_offering.lore1: Place it on the Sanguine Altar in the Slaughter Pit to challenge the Minotaur and his Cerberus again
block.hha_blood.cerberus_head_flame: Head of Cerberus: The Flame Maw
boss.hha_blood.line.intro.1: Deep below the lava sea lies the Slaughter Pit. The blood of the underworld seeps down here - and here Hades sends what even Tartarus cannot hold.
boss.hha_blood.line.intro.3: You smell of fear. Good. It tastes better that way.
boss.hha_blood.line.intro.3b: You wear blood that is not yours. I will take it back - drop by drop.
boss.hha_blood.line.intro.4: But first, my hound eats. CERBERUS!
boss.hha_blood.line.intro.again: You again? Cerberus... dinner is served!
boss.hha_blood.line.taunt.2: Run. He loves it when they run.
boss.hha_blood.line.taunt.5: My hound has eaten bigger things than you.
boss.hha_blood.line.rise.1: The guardian collapses. But its master is not done with it yet.
boss.hha_blood.line.rise.3: Drink the blood of the pit, my boy - and burn!
boss.hha_blood.line.fall.1: Three hearts beat one last time.
boss.hha_blood.line.fall.3: Hades entrusted him to me. Three hundred years he guarded this pit. And you... you took him from me.
boss.hha_blood.line.fall.4: Then I will butcher you myself!
boss.hha_blood.line.laby.2: Welcome to my labyrinth. In here, only one can find you: me.
boss.hha_blood.line.last.1: Cerberus... lend me your fire. One last time.
boss.hha_blood.line.last.2: The guardian's hellfire passes into its master.
boss.hha_blood.line.end.2: Tell Hades... his butcher fought to the last drop.
boss.hha_blood.line.end.3: The Butcher has fallen. The Slaughter Pit falls silent.
boss.hha_blood.line.reset: Back into the hole with the rest. The pit is waiting.
boss.hha_blood.line.intro.3h: You smell of feathers and Olympus. Did the messenger send you? No mail is delivered down here.
boss.hha_blood.line.intro.lore: Theseus slew me in my labyrinth. Hades gave me a new one. And the hound from his gate.
boss.hha_blood.line.rise.2b: Hades did not take you from his gate so you could crawl before mortals!
boss.hha_blood.line.fall.1b: But the hound of Hades cannot die. Its blood seeps back, down to the gate of the dead.
boss.hha_blood.line.laby.3: Theseus had a thread. You have none.
boss.hha_blood.line.hermes.1: Delivery! Delivery for whoever butchered the Butcher!
boss.hha_blood.line.hermes.1b: Oh, you again! We really have to stop meeting like this.
boss.hha_blood.line.hermes.2: Sender: Hades. He never writes twice, so better read it right away.
boss.hha_blood.line.hermes.letter: Black paper, written in ash: "I want the hound back. You may keep its heads - they grow back."
boss.hha_blood.line.hermes.3: There is something below it: "See you down there." If I were you, I would not hurry.
boss.hha_blood.line.hermes.again: Again? Hades sends word: as long as someone pours blood on the altar, those two come back. And I have to come all the way down here every time.
boss.hha_blood.hint.stunned: The Minotaur is stunned - strike now!
boss.hha_blood.hint.labyrinth: Walls rise - his charge breaks right through them!
boss.hha_blood.hint.heads: Body hits barely hurt - aim for the heads!
boss.hha_blood.hint.head_broken.0: The Render is broken - no more bleeding bites!
boss.hha_blood.hint.head_broken.1: The Furnace Maw is broken - no more fire!
boss.hha_blood.hint.head_broken.2: The Howler is broken - no more paralysing howls!
boss.hha_blood.line.laby.4: But the blood of the pit takes in everyone who bleeds here. Sink into it, and he will see you no more.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.1: I can smell your blood, little hero.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.2: Run. Every corridor here leads to me.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.3: Three thousand years in these halls. I know every stone.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.4: I can hear your heart. It beats so fast...
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.5: Come out, come out... the blood betrays you.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.6: You hide in blood? It is MY blood.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.7: Theseus was lucky. You are not.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.8: Do you hear that? That is my breath. Right behind you.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.9: Hades is watching. Don't disappoint him - at least die loudly.
boss.hha_blood.line.hunt.10: So quiet... like a grave. Yours.
boss.hha_blood.line.found.4: No thread will save you now!
boss.hha_blood.line.vanish.2: Sinking into the blood like a rat down a drain...
boss.hha_blood.line.scent.1: You were here. I can still smell it.
boss.hha_blood.line.scent.2: Warm... the trail is still warm.
boss.hha_blood.line.scent.4: Your fear stinks all the way over here.
boss.hha_blood.line.last.3: No axe. No labyrinth. I will tear you apart with my bare hands!
boss.hha_blood.line.last.4: The axe lies in the dust. The bull fights with fists, horns and his whole weight. Blood Trail stays with you.
boss.hha_blood.laby.intro: Press [%s]: sink into the blood - he can't see you. Don't run, he hears you!
boss.hha_blood.laby.ready: Blood Trail ready [%s] - in the blood he can't see you
boss.hha_blood.laby.hidden: In the blood (%ss) - sneak up: backstab x3!
boss.hha_blood.hint.heard: He hears you - sneak (Shift) or walk slowly!
boss.hha_blood.hint.stuck: The axe is stuck - strike now!
boss.hha_blood.hint.grab: He grabbed you! Hit him to break free!
boss.hha_blood.hint.grab_other: The Minotaur is holding someone - hit him!
boss.hha_blood.hint.fire_ring: A ring of fire is closing - get out while it is open, or get behind the Cerberus!
boss.hha_blood.hint.rockfall: The dome shakes - watch the shadows on the floor!
boss.hha_blood.hint.desperate: The Butcher is raging - he gives everything!

boss.hha_blood.protected: The Slaughter Pit cannot be changed.
boss.hha_blood.approach_moved: The pit has moved its entrance - the descent now begins here.
boss.hha_blood.reward.first: The Butcher has fallen. The pit is yours - and the three heads of his hound.
boss.hha_blood.reward.again: The Butcher falls again - but the pit has little left to give.
boss.hha_blood.altar.waiting: The Minotaur waits on his throne.
boss.hha_blood.altar.need: The altar demands a Blood Offering.
